clue.text: Charlie King tucked into greens and shellfish

indicators.note: tucked into says the two letters are pushed inside the word for greens

parts.note: cole is a cabbage or similar leafy green
Charlie is C in the radio alphabet
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A royal diner fills his plate of greens and shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: The cockle is a small edible bivalve mollusc, sold as seafood.

clue.text: US state accord is a disaster

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California
amity means friendly agreement or harmony

explanation.surface: A statement that some American state's peace pact has gone badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A calamity is a synonym for a catastrophe or great misfortune.

clue.text: Allow little time to cook fettucini

indicators.note: cooking the pasta stands for working its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction to leave very little time for the pasta to boil.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to leave barely enough margin, especially of time, for something.

clue.text: German composer is short of good fortune

indicators.note: is short of says the composer's name lacks a letter for good

parts.note: Christoph Willibald Gluck was a German opera composer

explanation.surface: A German composer is said to lack good fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'good fortune' reads as one phrase, but 'good' belongs to the wordplay and 'fortune' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Luck and fortune are synonyms for chance happenings, good or bad.

clue.text: Son's shoe found in the kitchen

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son, as in genealogies
a trainer is a sports shoe

explanation.surface: A boy's sports shoe has turned up in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a sieve is a thing found in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A sieve or colander for draining food is a standard kitchen utensil.

clue.text: Hopes to keep husband in forces

indicators.note: to keep says the first word holds the letter for husband inside it

parts.note: trusts means hopes or relies confidently

explanation.surface: A wife hopes to keep her husband in the armed forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forces' looks like military services, but it is a verb: pushes or shoves.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrusts as a verb means pushes or drives with force.

clue.text: Sign for a note? That's unexpected!

definitions.meaning: in music, a sharp, flat or natural sign altering a note is called this
something happening by chance, not planned

explanation.surface: A musical symbol prompts an exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the musical term for a sharp or flat sign and an adjective meaning by chance.

clue.text: Free from an upset when at rock bottom

indicators.note: upset in a down clue tips the pieces over so they read upwards

parts.note: rid means to free or clear

explanation.surface: Someone at their lowest point longs to escape an emotional upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' and 'when at' are link words; in a down clue 'upset' means read from the bottom up.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest point of anything, literally the point below an observer, is a synonym for rock bottom.

clue.text: Ray hid out in the capital

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: A man named Ray hid himself away in the capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Riyadh is the capital city of Saudi Arabia.

clue.text: Take advantage of 'obgoblin's stockings

parts.note: a hobgoblin is an imp; the apostrophe shows a dropped h, a manner of speech carried into the next word
hose are stockings; with the initial h dropped like the speaker's hobgoblin, it becomes ose

explanation.surface: A goblin, in dropped-h dialect, is said to be stealing someone's stockings.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped h in 'obgoblin signals the same h-dropping in the next word: hose said without its h.
explanation.definitionFit: To impose on someone is to take unfair advantage of their good nature.

clue.text: Meet Carol unexpectedly — she doesn't appear on time

indicators.note: unexpectedly hints that these letters arrive in a surprising order

explanation.surface: Meeting a woman called Carol by chance, since she never turns up punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who arrives late, after the start, is described by this word.

clue.text: Box for hoarding old copper in Cyprus

indicators.note: in says the advert and the old penny go inside the abbreviation for Cyprus

parts.note: CY is the international code for Cyprus
a hoarding is a billboard, which carries an ad
D was the abbreviation for an old pre-decimal penny, a copper coin

explanation.surface: A box for storing old copper coins out in Cyprus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word; 'hoarding' looks like storing, but it is a billboard giving AD.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea caddy is a small box or tin for keeping tea leaves.

clue.text: Came across Zionist leader in France

parts.note: met means came across or encountered

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone happened upon a Zionist leader while travelling in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the answer is a place located in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Metz is a city in north-eastern France, in Lorraine.

clue.text: Thought to be against partiality of the left

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
taking a side shows partiality or bias
red stands for the political left

explanation.surface: A view held to oppose the bias of left-wing politics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Considered as a past participle means thought or deemed, as in thought to be.

clue.text: Loans 'is shelter when managing to survive

parts.note: subs are advance payments or loans of money
the dialect spelling of is gives these two letters as they are
a tent is a portable shelter

explanation.surface: A borrower's dialect plea that a shelter is all they live on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Subsistent means existing or subsisting, keeping oneself alive on little.

clue.text: Commendation for US state beset by ethnic group

indicators.note: beset by says the state's abbreviation is surrounded by the group word

parts.note: a tribe is a social or ethnic group
UT is the postal abbreviation for Utah

explanation.surface: An award for an American state troubled by ethnic conflict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribute is an act or statement of praise or honour.

clue.text: Dramatist rewrites a scene

indicators.note: rewrites hints that the letters of the phrase are written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A playwright redrafts a scene of his drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Seneca the Younger was a Roman Stoic philosopher who wrote tragedies.

clue.text: Drink a great deal during musical finale

indicators.note: during says the quantity sits within the finale word

parts.note: a coda is the concluding passage of a piece of music
reams means a large amount

explanation.surface: Lots of drink consumed while a musical builds to its finale.
explanation.definitionFit: A vanilla-flavoured carbonated soft drink goes by this name.

clue.text: Weakened queen slipped away

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for regina, queen
elapsed means passed or slipped away, of time

explanation.surface: A queen has grown weaker and slipped away.
explanation.definitionFit: Relapsed means fell back into illness, so grew weaker again.

clue.text: Ridicule tons of tableware

parts.note: to tease is to mock or ridicule
T is the abbreviation for ton or tons

explanation.surface: Mocking someone for owning huge quantities of crockery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A matching set of cups, saucers and teapot is a set of tableware.

clue.text: Weepy toddler initially getting reprimand

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the next word

parts.note: an earful is a scolding or telling-off

explanation.surface: A child cries when told off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Tearful and weepy are synonyms for inclined to cry.

clue.text: Capture Zulu in east European bar

parts.note: to trap is to catch or capture

indicators.note: in says the Zulu letter goes between the two single-letter abbreviations

parts.note: Zulu is Z in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: A Zulu is seized at a bar in eastern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub, but it is a swinging bar for acrobats.
explanation.definitionFit: A trapeze is a horizontal bar hung from ropes, used by acrobats.

clue.text: Food the French block

parts.note: tack is food, as in hardtack ship's biscuit
le is a French word for the

explanation.surface: French food that clogs things up.
explanation.definitionFit: In football or rugby, to tackle an opponent is to block or stop them.

clue.text: Wit of copper getting in the last word

indicators.note: getting in says the metal symbol enters the closing word

parts.note: amen is the last word of a prayer
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A policeman's cleverness lets him have the last word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word; 'copper' suggests a policeman but gives the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Acumen is sharpness of mind, a sense of wit as shrewdness.

clue.text: Ford's access door provides shade

parts.note: to ford a river is to cross it
a hatch is a small opening or door giving access

explanation.surface: A Ford car's access door provides shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ford' looks like the car maker, but it is a verb; 'provides' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosshatching is shading drawn with sets of intersecting parallel lines.

clue.text: Bird giving cry of pain suffered

parts.note: ow is an exclamation of pain
suffered in the old sense of allowed gives let

explanation.surface: A bird crying out in pain at what it endured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving' is a link word; 'suffered' is in its old sense of permitted, as in 'suffer the little children'.
explanation.definitionFit: An owlet is a young owl, which is a bird.

clue.text: Girl takes part in requiem mass

indicators.note: takes part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A young woman joins in a funeral service.
explanation.definitionFit: Emma is a female first name, standing for any girl.

clue.text: Individual caught cold in days gone by

indicators.note: caught says the first word holds the letter for cold

parts.note: one means a single individual
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone once caught a cold long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Once means formerly, at some time in the past.

clue.text: First person to find fish's turned creates rumpus

parts.note: me is the first-person pronoun

indicators.note: turned says the fish word is turned around

parts.note: an eel is a fish; the 's is a link meaning is

explanation.surface: The first to discover the fish has gone off causes an uproar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to find' and 'creates' are link words; 'turned' sounds like fish going bad but reverses EEL to LEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A melee is a confused fight or noisy scuffle, so a rumpus.

clue.text: Foul noise disturbed criminal

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters are stirred out of place

explanation.surface: A nasty racket disturbed the neighbours, which ought to be a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Felonious means relating to or involving a serious crime.

clue.text: A heavyweight, taken aback, gets high? Don't mention it!

indicators.note: taken aback says the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: a ton is a heavy unit of weight
tall means high

explanation.surface: A heavy boxer, startled, gets lofty, and is told to say nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are polite replies to thanks, saying no trouble was taken.

clue.text: Embarrassed about fighting for prize

indicators.note: about says the colour word goes around the fighting word

parts.note: red, as in red-faced, means embarrassed
war is armed fighting

explanation.surface: A fighter blushes when it comes to fighting for a prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A reward is a prize given for an achievement.
